title: CSS Animation Performance

bugs.explanation: `width` and `margin` changes trigger layout reflow on every animation frame — expensive on the GPU. Use `transform: translateX()` and `scaleX()` instead, which are composited on the GPU and don't cause layout or paint.

title: Compositor-only Properties

bugs.explanation: Animating `left`/`top`/`bottom`/`right` triggers layout recalculations on every frame. Use `transform: translate()` instead — it's handled by the compositor thread without layout or paint, giving buttery-smooth 60fps animations.

title: Avoiding Layout Thrashing

bugs.explanation: Reading layout properties (`offsetWidth`) and then writing (`style.height`) in the same loop causes layout thrashing — the browser must recalculate layout for each iteration. Batch reads together, then batch writes. First read all widths, then write all heights.

title: requestAnimationFrame for Smooth Updates

bugs.explanation: Use `requestAnimationFrame` instead of `setInterval` for visual updates — rAF syncs with the browser's render cycle (typically 60fps), avoids updates when the tab is hidden, and produces smoother animations. Also use `transform` instead of `left`.
